svg.title: V-04 · KeepMeAwake: Keeps a laptop awake by asking the operating system nicely: a Windows power request or a macOS power assertion, never a fake keypress. Timers, schedules, battery rules, an overnight guard and an almanac of hours, in about 5 MB. A pure Rust core with every OS call behind a trait, signed auto-updates, and five decision records. Stack: Rust, Tauri 2, Svelte 5, Win32 power requests, IOKit, Windows and macOS.
